rows.text: You hear a muffled gurgling sound which seems to come from something swimming in the water. Slowly, you turn around and see a familiar face leaning over an experiment bench, adding some nutrients into an incubator. The bizarre but beautiful creature inside makes a spin in the nutrient solution, as if expressing delight.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "You came at a good time." Ruan Mei pauses her work and regards you with amusement. "This batch will soon be completed. It's a shame that you probably can't stay in the world slice for too long."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The little guy in the incubator imitates Ruan Mei's moves and pokes its body out of the water, trying to listen to your voices.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Maybe... they'll bring a small surprise for this Simulated Universe." With her eyes downcast, Ruan Mei playfully interacts with the innocent creation in the water using her fingertips.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Change is a norm in the universe. No scholar would expect data to stay static. The mutations in the depth of genes and the anomalies in collision experiments..." Ruan Mei casts a relaxed glance at her creations in the lab with a faint and amused smile. "This kind of surprise isn't frowned upon in science because they often lead to breakthroughs."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Alright, time to retrieve the surprise that belongs to you."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Obtain one 3-star Equation. Obtain random Blessings needed to activate the Equations currently in possession until all possessed Equations are expanded.
